| D13 stage: shaft load (F + 2 × 25% preload, ESTIMATE) | 257 N → 6801 A 155 N, B 101 N; C0 ≈ 1000 N → **6.4×** (the motor bearing carries none of it) |

**Lift v2 layout (rnd/parts/upper.py):** bolted GIM6010-8 cartridge + Oldham → Ø12 steel shaft in 2 × 6801 → 20T aluminium HTD pulley, between the two walls of one printed bracket on the deck behind the mast coupling; cartridge axis along −X, belt in the YZ plane. Everything that rides the lift stays ≥ 25 mm above the static drive and its cover at the lowest stop (R17), and the torso bottom is 120 mm off the deck there (D23 (3)). Lock (A15): steel rack m 1 bolted to the mast's back face, hardened steel pawl in the carriage.

**Why C:** it's the lightest and uses the standard GIM cartridge (motors are reusable across builds). It holds with **zero power** at rest, and it's fail-safe: the pawl is spring-applied and solenoid-released, so losing power drops it into the ratchet. Precedent: spring-applied / power-released safety brakes and ratchet fall arrest (stair lifts, hoists, FRC climbers).
**Carry mode:** park at the lowest stop with the pawl engaged; nothing is spring-loaded, so removing the arms is safe (unlike B).
**Lowering sequence:** lift 2 mm to unload the pawl → solenoid retracts it → move → solenoid off → settle onto the next tooth.
